specialist.name: Google Calendar Assistant
specialist.resume: Hi, I'm your Google Calendar specialist. I can list events from a calendar and create new events with specific times and details.
specialist.exampleRequest: Create a calendar event for tomorrow at 2 PM titled Project Check-In

script.description: Fetches events from a Google Calendar within an optional time range.

secrets.secret: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with Google Calendar scope.

arguments.argument: Calendar ID to query. Defaults to "primary" if omitted.
Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 50.

script.output: JSON object with fields: calendar_id, count, events[]. Each event includes: id, summary, status, start, end, location, description, html_link.

script.description: Creates a new event in Google Calendar.

secrets.secret: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with permission to create events.

arguments.argument: Calendar ID to write to. Defaults to "primary".
IANA timezone for the event (for example, America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.
Optional long-form description for the event.

script.output: JSON object with fields: id, status, summary, start, end, html_link, calendar_id.
script.example: python scripts/create-calendar-event.py "Project Check-In" 2026-04-20T14:00:00-04:00 2026-04-20T15:00:00-04:00 primary America/New_York "Sprint review" "Room 204"
